description.value: Golden Village Lodge is a 76-unit property situated at the east entrance of Golden, BC, on the Trans-Canada Highway in Kicking Horse Canyon, tucked between the Rocky and Purcell Mountain ranges. It markets itself as a comfortable, scenic base for Canadian Rockies travel — a convenient stop for cyclists riding the Trans-Canada corridor or approaching Yoho National Park. The lodge emphasizes spacious units and a home-away-from-home atmosphere.
